summary: Iteration 86 - Secondary Currency Support & Permission Modules. All backend tests passed (18/18). Frontend features verified: Currency dropdowns in PO/Quotation forms, new permission modules in Role Groups, Support ticket assignee dropdown.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed Tax Invoice QR code generation for non-INR currency)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 86 verified: (1) Secondary currency support (INR/USD/EUR/GBP/AED) in PO, Quotation, Proforma, Tax Invoice - non-INR documents have GST=0, (2) /api/users/assignable endpoint returns light user list for any authenticated user, (3) New permission modules inventory_sale_price, inventory_purchase_price, inventory_configuration visible in Role Groups permissions matrix, (4) Inventory Configuration link in sidebar gated by inventory_configuration permission, (5) Support ticket assignee dropdown populated from /api/users/assignable.

backend_currency_support.details: 18/18 tests passed. PO/Quotation/Proforma/Tax Invoice with non-INR currency have total_gst=0. Currency flipping (INR→USD) recomputes GST correctly. Proforma inherits currency from quotation. Tax Invoice QR code is empty for non-INR (fixed during testing).

backend_assignable_users.details: GET /api/users/assignable returns light user list (id, name, email) for any authenticated user. GET /api/users remains admin-only.

backend_permission_modules.details: GET /api/users/modules includes inventory_sale_price, inventory_purchase_price, inventory_configuration with view-only actions.

frontend_po_currency_dropdown.details: PO Create dialog has Currency dropdown (data-testid='po-currency-select') with options: INR — ₹, USD — $, EUR — €, GBP — £, AED — د.إ. Label shows '(non-INR ⇒ no GST)' hint.

frontend_quotation_currency_dropdown.details: Quotation Create dialog has Currency dropdown (data-testid='quotation-currency') with same 5 currency options.

frontend_role_group_permissions.details: Role Group permissions matrix shows 3 new modules: 'Stock — Sale Price (visibility)', 'Stock — Purchase Price (visibility)', 'Inventory Configuration' - all with view-only checkboxes.

frontend_support_assignee.details: Support Ticket form has Assignee dropdown (data-testid='ticket-assignee') populated with users from /api/users/assignable.

frontend_inventory_configuration_link.details: Inventory sidebar group shows Configuration link (href='/inventory/configuration', data-testid='nav-configuration') gated by inventory_configuration permission.

frontend_header_role_display.details: Header shows 'admin' badge and 'System Admin' name. Sidebar bottom shows 'System Admin' and 'admin@erp.com'.

tax_invoice_qr_code.issue: Tax Invoice QR code was generated for non-INR currency (export invoices)
tax_invoice_qr_code.fix: Added currency check - QR code only generated for INR invoices, empty string for non-INR
